highlights: The AI agent landscape is maturing rapidly with new tools for optimizing research experiments and standardizing computer-use agent development, promising significant efficiency gains.

Open-source models continue to push boundaries, featuring performant on-device solutions like OpenBMB's MiniCPM5-2B and comprehensive model fleets from IFM, making advanced AI more accessible to developers.

Developer tooling is improving accessibility for local AI deployment and efficient on-device processing, exemplified by one-click setups and WebGPU kernels, alongside specialized tools for robotics data engines.

agents.title: Meta FAIR Introduces AI Research Preference Models (RPMs)
agents.summary: Meta FAIR introduced AI Research Preference Models (RPMs), enabling LLM judges to rank unexecuted ML experiments, reducing GPU hours and accelerating research timelines by roughly 37%.

agents.title: UC Berkeley Researchers Release CUA-Lite: Open Platform for Computer-Use Agents
agents.summary: UC Berkeley researchers released CUA-Lite, an open platform that unifies sandboxes, data, evaluation, and RL for computer-use agents, streamlining development with lightweight Docker containers.

agents.title: GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration
agents.summary: GitHub's Project HydraFusion introduces runtime multi-model orchestration for Copilot CLI, optimizing workflow selection for coding tasks through patterns like Single, Cascade, and Critique to enhance efficiency.

models.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: On-Device Dense Model with Strong Benchmarks
models.summary: OpenBMB released MiniCPM5-2B, a 2.52B dense causal language model optimized for on-device deployment, achieving an average score of 53.9 across 34 benchmarks with strong performance in tool use and long-context retrieval, available under Apache 2.0.

models.title: IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B
models.summary: The Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) unveiled K2 Horizon, a fleet of six Apache 2.0 licensed models ranging from 0.9B to 375B parameters, alongside their pre-training corpus, offering a comprehensive suite for various applications.

models.title: Reducto Releases r-1: Single Pass Document Parsing Model
models.summary: Reducto's r-1 is a single-pass document parsing model that integrates OCR, layout detection, and grounding, reducing errors by 20% and significantly cutting costs to 1 cent per page compared to multi-stage pipelines.

tools.title: Nous Research Adds One-Click Local Model Setup to Hermes Desktop
tools.summary: Nous Research integrated one-click local model setup into Hermes Desktop, simplifying the deployment of LLMs by automatically fit-checking hardware, selecting optimal models, and configuring llama.cpp for local execution.

tools.title: Hugging Face Introduces @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face released `@huggingface/kernels`, a collection of over 200 WebGPU kernels designed for efficient local AI processing, enabling developers to build performant on-device AI applications.

tools.title: Axis Robotics Releases AXIS: Browser-Based Data Engine for Robot Manipulation
tools.summary: Axis Robotics launched AXIS, a browser-based data engine providing 207 robot manipulation tasks and 50,129 verified trajectories, accelerating robot learning by moving demonstration collection to the web with backend GPU processing.

companies.title: Google AI Blog: Proactive cyber defense for governments and enterprises (Fairwind Program)
companies.summary: Google introduced the Fairwind Program, offering limited access to its advanced AI-powered cyber defense tools for governments and trusted partners, strengthening enterprise security.

companies.title: Google AI Blog: AMIE, research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation
companies.summary: Google's AMIE, a research medical AI system, demonstrated real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in simulated studies, showcasing significant potential for AI in healthcare diagnostics and support.

companies.title: GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration
companies.summary: GitHub's Project HydraFusion is a research preview for runtime multi-model orchestration within Copilot CLI, optimizing coding workflows by dynamically selecting execution patterns (Single, Cascade, Critique) for specific tasks.

learning.title: Google AI Blog: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Google and Kaggle hosted a no-cost AI Agents Intensive, a massive coding course engaging 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, providing extensive upskilling.

learning.title: Hugging Face Blog: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: This Hugging Face guide provides insights and techniques for training and fine-tuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, crucial for advanced retrieval and semantic search applications.

learning.title: Hugging Face Blog: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
learning.summary: A Hugging Face blog post offers a comprehensive guide to building, running, and deploying AI workflows efficiently using Gradio, empowering developers to create interactive AI applications rapidly.
